question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"resource."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"resource"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• **"Resource"** refers to something that can be used to achieve a particular purpose. (उपयोग के लिए उपलब्‍ध सामग्री; संसाधन)
 
 
• **Example**: *Russia is rich in natural **resources**__ such as oil and minerals.*
 
 
 
• Grammatically, **"resource"** is a noun and can be used as both a countable and uncountable noun.
 
• In this context, it is referring to something that can be used to achieve a particular goal or objective.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

The world is becoming increasingly (1) __**urbanised**__. Since 2007, more than half of the world's population has been living in cities, and that share is (2) __**projected**__ to rise to 60 percent by 2030. Cities and metropolitan areas are powerhouses of economic growth- (3)__** contributing**__ about 60 percent of global GDP. However, they also account for about 70 percent of global carbon emissions and over 60 percent of (4) **__resource__ **use. Rapid urbanisation is resulting in a growing number of slum dwellers, inadequate and (5)________ infrastructure and services, worsening air pollution, and unplanned urban sprawl.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "wealth"**, refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money. ((किसी की) धन-संपत्ति, ज़मीन-जायदाद; संपन्‍नता, अमीरी)
 
• **Option 2, "nature"**, refers to the physical world and its phenomena. (प्रकृति, ब्रह्मांड में स्थित समस्‍त पेड़-पौधे, जीव-जंतु आदि और उसमें होने वाली सब क्रिया जो मानव-निर्मित या प्रेरित नहीं)
 
• **Option 3, "assets"**, refers to something that is owned by an individual or organization that has value. (कोई ऐसी चीज़ जिसका स्वामित्व किसी व्यक्ति या संगठन के पास हो जिसका मूल्य हो)
